# σ-algebra generated by a subset

## Summary

We call $ < epsilon > := inter.big_(epsilon subset.eq S subset.eq cal(P)\(X\)\,thin S upright(" is ") sigma upright(" -algebra on ") X) S $ the $sigma$-algebra generated by $epsilon$

## Evidence

```
\begin{definition}{\kn{$\sigma$-algebra generated by a subset}}

We call

\[< \varepsilon > := \bigcap\limits_{\varepsilon \subseteq S \subseteq \mathcal{P}(X),\, S\ \text{is}\ \sigma\ \text{-algebra on}\ X}S\]

\textbf{the \(\sigma\)-algebra generated by \(\varepsilon\)}

\end{definition}
```
